annotations.title: Which US ETFs hold a stock, and at what weight

description: For one stock, the covered US ETFs that hold it and the weight in each, heaviest first, with each fund's holdings date and whether it comes from the issuer's daily file or an SEC filing. Returns the largest holders and the total count.

ticker.description: A stock ticker, for example NVDA. A line listed outside the US carries its market after a dot, for example 7203.JP (Toyota in Tokyo), SAN.FR (Sanofi in Paris) or 005930.KR (Samsung Electronics); an earlier key without the market, such as 7203, is read as the key it became.

top.description: How many funds to return, heaviest first.
